correctness.rationale: The marked Kac identity E[L_cycle^m; J=j]=m!P(J=j)G^m follows by the ordered-time killed semigroup with r-exponential survival and Markov conditioning at the final visit to the reset/local-time site. It proves single-cycle exponential local time independent of success/reset mark. I.i.d. cycles and a geometric stopping index give the exact bivariate transform and density; summing/inverting gives the Poisson/Gamma conditionals, and direct moment arithmetic gives Corr(N,L)=sqrt(1-h). The argument uses explicitly finite positive h and G and the occupation-density normalization. A standalone scipy/numpy diagnostic checked the direct backward equation against separately computed killed CTMC resolvents for three parameter sets, 25 Laplace/PGF points each; checked OU and Brownian closed forms; 462 assertions passed. No finite experiment substitutes for this continuum proof.

value.rationale: N is an intervention cost and L is occupation/exposure at a controlled location. The exact conditional reset-count distribution given measured exposure and the universal correlation resolve the full coupling of two physically important observables in the OU and general one-dimensional class, beyond existing independent marginal formulae. The answer includes a concrete finite-rate OU parameter evaluation and a free-diffusion closed form; not merely a textbook mean or an arbitrary slice.
